_readme: The M2 cargo order (CargoPlan, src/levels/cargo_plan.gd; the console's Planning tab). Owned by Fahd.
Every number here is a game assumption unless game/docs/SCIENCE_AND_DATA.md gives a source for it. Item masses are not listed: CargoPlan reads them from the part scenes.
services: limit_kg is the delivered payload limit (items plus packaging_kg); arrival_day is story days after the order; phases are [label, story day] for the flight panel.

items: parts are the part scenes it delivers. stock names the workshop slots (rack: RackStock child names, bench: BenchStock child names) that stay empty until it is delivered. crate: its parts go to Rafi's cargo crate (CargoPlan.crate_parts()), not to the rack.

lunar_day: local days since sunrise. order_day matches the Moon level's sun (16.7 degrees up in the east); M3 happens m3_after_delivery_days after arrival and is near nightfall when it falls within nightfall_margin_days of sunset; then night_required items must be ordered. M3 shows its own sun: morning_azimuth (the level sun's) before local noon, mirrored about the meridian after it.

services.name: Courier lander
services.description: Small, fast lander, lands in daylight. Little room: no space for the grip wheels, so Kite must take the long route.

services.name: Freighter lander
services.description: Larger, slower lander on a low-energy transfer. Room for everything, but it lands near nightfall: Kite needs the thermal kit.

items.name: Standard battery, 100 Wh
items.description: 2.5 times the energy for 2 kg more. Kite's 40 Wh pack can't reach the far rim and back.

items.name: High-grip wheels (4)
items.description: Traction for the short, rough route to the far rim.

items.name: Thermal kit
items.description: Cover and heater for the electronics bay. Needed in shade.

items.name: Sampling kit
items.description: Scoop and two sample containers for the near and far sites. Required: M2 needs the near sample.
